full_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept; asset type: original SNES-style fighting-game airborne, throw and recovery source atlas.

Input Image 1 is the existing Damián 16-pose master and identity reference. Image 2 is the approved Damián action-transition atlas and secondary anatomy/style reference. Preserve the bald friendly adult face, long oval head, prominent ears, gentle eyelids, rounded long nose, wide toothy smile, cobalt rolled-sleeve blazer, open white collar, navy trousers, black shoes, warm peach skin, compact broad-shouldered anatomy, limited cel shading and dark navy outline.

Create a new transparent 1254x1254 square 4-column by 4-row sprite atlas with exactly sixteen separately drawn full-body figures for frames 48 through 63. Every figure is one complete connected fighter, with generous transparent gaps and room around prone figures. All figures face right except frame 59 ground impact and frame 61 knockdown fall, whose head is clearly to the left.

Frame 48 must be an upright neutral standing guard matching the original atlas idle in head-to-feet height, bald head proportions, compact stance and costume. It is the single normalization anchor. Keep every airborne/recovery figure compact enough for the existing 96x80 native canvas and 94x77 safe region; never make an airborne limb wider than the existing long side kick or KO pose.

Row-major order: 48 upright neutral standing guard; 49 visibly airborne air-punch anticipation with knees lifted; 50 visibly airborne air-punch active extension; 51 visibly airborne air-punch retract toward airborne guard. 52 visibly airborne air-kick anticipation with knee chambered; 53 visibly airborne air-kick active extension; 54 visibly airborne air-kick retract; 55 compact neutral air/apex guard with bent knees. 56 thrower contact/grip reaching both arms toward an implied opponent beyond the cell; 57 thrower release/turn with readable hip and shoulder force; 58 victim lifted and off balance with contained limbs; 59 victim ground impact with body low and head left. 60 compact knockdown launch/recoil with face right; 61 diagonal knockdown fall with head left; 62 grounded get-up with one planted hand and one planted foot; 63 wake-up guard returning to upright neutral.

Style: polished hand-drawn 16-bit arcade fighting-game cartoon with original readable silhouettes, two-to-four value cel shading, strong dark contour, natural anatomy and weight. Keep Damián's facial likeness and cobalt costume consistent. Redraw joints, torso, hips, limbs and balance for every in-between; do not translate, stretch, mirror or copy whole bodies.

Strict constraints: actual transparent alpha; exactly 16 separate figures in a 4x4 grid; at least 40 pixels of transparent separation; no figures touching or crossing cells; no labels, text, shadows, floor, projectile, energy, smoke, effects, props, opponent, logos or watermark; no cropped head, hands or feet, fused figures, extra limbs, independent cell shrinking, photorealism, 3D, generic fighters or copied commercial sprites.
